units_notice: Counts indicate ECFS filings, not verified unique people or population opinion.
issue_method: Case-insensitive phrase/term presence searched over all available augmented text; nonexclusive; not pro/anti or necessarily substantive endorsement.

issues.label: E-Rate sunset / narrowing
issues.query: sunset, eliminate, terminate, phase out or E-Rate funding cuts

issues.label: Screen-time restrictions
issues.query: screen time, screen-time, screen-use, limiting time on screens

issues.label: Procurement / competitive bidding
issues.query: competitive bidding, Forms 470/471, lowest corresponding price

issues.label: Discount formula
issues.query: discount matrix, school lunch, NSLP, discount rates

role_method: Nonexclusive filer descriptions are reduced to a single provisional primary category using ordered lexical cues from public ECFS filer fields. These categories are not independently verified and 'unresolved' can include organizational representatives.

directional_signals.label: Explicit language to preserve, continue, protect, strengthen or sustain E-Rate, or reject its elimination
directional_signals.scope: Regex detection within first 40,000 and last 20,000 characters for submissions over 120,000 characters; full text otherwise. Detected phrases are not independently dual-coded.
directional_signals.manual_spot_check: 27 randomly drawn matching excerpts inspected; all 27 appeared to advocate continuity, but the sample is small and form language dominates.

directional_caveat: The 1,481 count is a reproducible explicit-wording signal, not a complete prevalence estimate of all supporters or an independently validated classifier. We do not publish an automatic pro-sunset count: an initial pattern falsely matched 175 filings quoting the FCC proposal.
